addressing_rules.physical: P001..P111 count engraved bars once, top-to-bottom and left-to-right, without unfolding repeats.
addressing_rules.onsets: Rational quarters from 0 inside each physical bar; capacity 2.
addressing_rules.staffs: Global 1=upper, 2=lower; part-local indices 1 and 2 of P1; one piano player.
addressing_rules.crops: All boxes and barline x positions use the frozen full-page raster coordinate space. PIL half-open crop boxes.
addressing_rules.repeats: P001..P021 first section; P022..P111 second section. Compound repeat strokes do not add bars.
addressing_rules.last_region: P111 is one complete two-quarter bar of rest; the printed 1 counts the rest bar and is not a fingering.

fingering_policy: Preserve any printed fingerings at note/chord-member addresses in downstream authoritative MusicXML; distinguish digits from tuplet and rest-count numerals. Full pages retain all evidence.
crop_policy: Complete frozen edition pages retained, no trimming. Twelve deterministic children inspected against exact, context and marked-page views. Tight corridors are soft warnings.
